method: Independently reopened 18 hash-verified announcement PDF originals and read all cited physical pages, inspected current/prior year and three/six-month table headers, parsed the exact source excerpts from fresh default/layout extraction, verified current H1 third income column/Q2 first income column, two-column stock and H1 cash flows, units, periods and statement identities. Compared all fields with separate formal reports as corroboration only.
